parameter_semantics: target_object selects current red_pose as the chunk action frame; successor_object selects blue_pose for overlap conditioning; buffer_pose_world is [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] in world metres and wxyz and identifies the free destination. Training binds [-0.181,0,0.02,1,0,0,0]. Object poses refresh at every replan.
output_semantics: Each prediction slot is [p_x,p_y,p_z,r6_0..r6_5,gripper], where p is metres and r6 is the first two rotation-matrix columns of the commanded TCP pose expressed in the red pose observed at chunk start. The red anchor is fixed for the sampled chunk. Safe Gram-Schmidt projects r6 to SO(3); exact training labels are unchanged. The local pose is composed to world, then panda_kinematics.solve_ik uses freshly measured qpos. Gripper scalar preserves native sign semantics. Slots represent t-1..t+14 and execution uses slots 1..8.

conversion_check.description: FK command poses are encoded relative to chunk-start red and decoded by the inverse composition. The check compares world TCP position, rotation and gripper; nonunique IK is allowed, and safe 6D projection only handles degenerate sampled rotations.

cut_relation: All actions in each assigned [0,stop) segment are supervised, including 210-230 actions shared with place_blue from final red lowering/release through retreat, blue closure and initial lift. No cut is trimmed or reassigned.
